title: Well status board and deferment log
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met: a deferment cannot be saved without a reason code from the reference set; overlapping deferments are flagged rather than merged; a deferred volume carries its unit; the totals by reason equal the sum of the rows; and an ongoing deferment is distinct from a closed one with its elapsed hours.

dataModel.decision: The feature's open question - 'deferment may be derived from status history rather than stored separately; confirm with the service before creating a second record type' - was answered from the records: PPDM's WELL_STATUS carries the status, a status type and a start/end time, but no deferred volume and no coded reason. A deferment that explains lost volume therefore needs its own row, so PRD-03 adds PRODUCTION_DEFERMENT and the reference set R_DEFERMENT_REASON to the ProductionOperations module, and the board still reads WELL_STATUS for the status itself.
tables: PRODUCTION_DEFERMENT (DEFERMENT_ID key, WELL_ID, FIELD_ID, START_AT, END_AT, REASON_CODE, DEFERRED_VOLUME, VOLUME_OUOM, COMMENT, REPORTER, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT) - END_AT null means ongoing
R_DEFERMENT_REASON (REASON_CODE key, REASON_NAME, CATEGORY, ACTIVE_IND) - the code book; not seeded, because the taxonomy is the operating company's data
dataModel.registration: FacilityManagementModuleSetup registers both types; --smoke now reports 378 entity types (up from 376).
dataModel.reads: PPDM WELL, WELL_STATUS, PDEN_WELL and PDEN_VOL_SUMMARY for the board, the status history and each well's last-day rate.

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Production/OgWellStatusBoard.cs (OgDeferment, OgWellCard, OgStatusGroup, OgReasonTotal, OgWellStatusBoard, OgDefermentValues, DefermentRules, IOgWellStatusDeferment, OgWellStatusDefermentService with LoadAsync/LogDefermentAsync/CloseDefermentAsync)
implementation.rules: DefermentRules states the elapsed-hours rule, the overlap rule (an ongoing deferment is open-ended), validation (well, start, end order, reason in the set, volume with its unit, reporter) and the totals-by-reason rule once, so the page and the tests agree.
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/DefermentLogPageView.cs (route 'deferments': status board grouped by status, well cards with rate/reason/since, the deferment log with duration and overlap column, totals by reason, the logger, the close action, the reason reference, failure panel)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgWellStatusDeferment), OgApplication.WellStatusDeferment, catalog 'deferments' (OgModuleKeys.Production), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/DefermentTests.cs (11, no database) + DefermentGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite over the PPDM status tables and the two new tables)

commands.well-status-notice: The well status could not be read.

integration.database: SQLite with the PPDM WELL, WELL_STATUS, R_WELL_STATUS, PDEN_WELL and PDEN_VOL_SUMMARY tables and the new R_DEFERMENT_REASON and PRODUCTION_DEFERMENT, seeded in DefermentGatewayTests: three wells in F-1 plus one in F-2, status history, two reason codes and one inactive code, one closed and one ongoing deferment
integration.board: the field's three wells group as producing (2) and suspended (1); WELL-1 shows its 120 bbl last-day rate and the open deferment's coded reason; the other field's well is absent
integration.ac1_reason: a deferment with no reason is refused with deferment-reason-required and the set is listed in the message; an unknown code and an inactive code are refused with deferment-reason-unknown; an empty reference set refuses with deferment-reason-reference-missing
integration.ac2_overlap: a deferment starting inside the open one is saved, both are flagged, OverlapCount reads 2, and the page lists them rather than merging them
integration.ac3_unit: a deferred volume with no unit is refused with deferment-volume-unit-required; a negative volume with deferment-volume-invalid
integration.ac4_totals: EQ-FAIL totals 175 bbl over 2 rows and WEATHER 40 bbl over 1 row after the overlap is added; the register's totals sum equals the sum of the rows, and the field total reads 215 bbl
integration.ac5_ongoing: the open deferment reads 'ongoing' and '6 h so far' style durations; closing it sets END_AT, drops it from the ongoing count and fixes its elapsed hours; closing it twice is refused with deferment-already-closed and closing before the start with deferment-end-before-start
integration.failed_read: dropping PRODUCTION_DEFERMENT makes LoadAsync fail with a reference and no workspace

gates.AC-1 A deferment cannot be saved without: pass - Validate refuses a missing code, a code not in the active set (naming the set) and an empty reference set, and LogDefermentAsync revalidates against the table it just read; proven against SQLite for all three.
gates.AC-2 Overlapping deferments are flagged: pass - every row carries the ids of the same well's deferments whose intervals intersect it (an ongoing row is open-ended), the board counts them, and the page shows the count; the overlap is saved, never merged or refused.
gates.AC-3 Deferred volume carries a unit: pass - a volume above zero without VOLUME_OUOM is refused with deferment-volume-unit-required, and every volume renders through the shared formatter which names a missing unit.
gates.AC-4 Totals by reason equal the sum of r: pass - DefermentRules.Totals groups the same list the grid shows, sums within one unit per reason and names a mixed pair instead of adding it; the gateway test compares the totals to the rows' own sum.
gates.AC-5 An ongoing deferment is distinct fr: pass - END_AT null is IsOngoing, the page reads 'ongoing' with its elapsed hours, a closed row shows its end and fixed duration, and closing is refused on an already-closed row.

incident.what: While adding this feature's page, `src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/WellStatusPageView.cs` - the WEL-04 well status page - was overwritten by a new file of the same name, because the new page's class name collided with it.
incident.effect: The WEL-04 page's source was lost for a few minutes. The build and the full suite still passed because the restored-from-memory replacement compiled, but the route/class collision would have broken the WEL-04 page's wiring (`wellstatus` -> WellStatusPageView) at runtime.
incident.repair: The WEL-04 page was rewritten faithfully against the intact WEL-04 service (WELL-04's OgWellStatus and OgWellStatusView are untouched): Route 'wellstatus', OpenPending()/Open(), Pending, LastFailed, ReferenceDataMissing, NoticeText, the history grid and the change form. This feature's page was moved to its own class DefermentLogPageView with route 'deferments'. Verified afterwards: --smoke still reports well-status-route: wellstatus, well-status-fails-cleanly-without-table: True, well-status-reference-missing: False and the same notice, and the 815 desktop tests (including WellStatusTests and WellStatusGatewayTests) pass.
incident.note: The repository is not under version control, so nothing could be recovered from history; the restoration was written from the page's own obligations and the smoke contract that names its members.

limits: Deferment is not derived from the status history: WELL_STATUS cannot hold a deferred volume or a coded reason, so PRODUCTION_DEFERMENT is its own record. The status itself still comes from WELL_STATUS, and the two are linked by the well, not by a foreign key.

R_DEFERMENT_REASON is deliberately not seeded: the deferment taxonomy is the operating company's (or the regulator's) data. Until rows exist the page says so and refuses every deferment, rather than accepting free text.
The board shows every well of the field, active or not, because a suspended well is exactly what a deferment explains; the 'active wells' count belongs to PRD-01.
A well's rate on the card is its most recent reported day's oil volume, not a deferred-adjusted or theoretical rate.

Overlapping deferments are permitted and flagged. The feature says 'flagged, not silently merged', so no rule refuses them and no volume is de-duplicated; the totals therefore include overlaps, and the page says how many rows overlap.
The deferred volume is summed within one unit per reason and across the field; two units are named rather than converted.
The feature's permissions (production.deferment.write, production.read) are not enforced per command: the app gates pages.
The status board in this page is a read of the same PPDM status the WEL-04 page changes; there is no status-change control here, so the two pages do not compete for the write.
